# Font Awesome Free 6.5.1

Self-hosted, unchanged CSS and webfonts from npm `@fortawesome/fontawesome-free@6.5.1`.
Upstream: https://github.com/FortAwesome/Font-Awesome/tree/6.5.1
Replaces the existing third-party CDN dependency; no runtime CDN requests.
